_comment: ALL player-facing text for 'Escape the Derelict'. No code lives here. world.js holds only structure + logic and merges this in by id. This is the JSON-content-file pattern Andy proposed: prose in data, behaviour in code.

config.winBanner: You blast free of the derelict. Deep space swallows the wreck behind you.

cabin.name: Crew Cabin
cabin.desc: A cramped bunk room aboard a derelict freighter. A hatch leads north.

corridor.name: Corridor
corridor.desc: A dim service corridor. The bridge is north; a maintenance shaft drops down.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.desc: Dead consoles and one escape pod, sealed behind a keycard reader.

shaft.name: Maintenance Shaft
shaft.desc: A black crawlspace of cables and coolant.

pod.desc: A one-seat escape pod behind a keycard reader.

salvage.message: [+5] Salvage: you pocketed the crew keycard.

spelunker.message: [+5] Spelunker: you survived the maintenance shaft.

messages.podLocked: The reader blinks red. It needs a keycard.
messages.podLaunch: You slot the blue keycard. The pod's clamps release and it fires clear.
